opportunity.sector: Computer-assisted mathematics and reusable proof certificates
opportunity.thesis: An exact rational polynomial certificate replaces unbounded enumeration with a universal lower bound, independently recomputed in two implementations. This is a mathematical research result; priority, external review, commercial demand and model superiority are separate questions.
opportunity.goal: Verify h > 1891871140656049/1929687500000000 for every finite exact residue-class partition with at least two points per class.
opportunity.successMetric: Two independently derived exact certificate implementations agree; all 78 short-class patches, the infinite-length tail and every finite n pass; the known invalid grid witness is refused. No external peer review or production qualification is asserted.

sources.excerpt: The author defines distinct-modulus residue classes that partition 1 through n, each containing at least two interval elements, and asks whether any has total reciprocal modulus below 0.98. August 2026 updates address other directions. This paraphrase records the inspected question, not an ownership claim.

witness.theorem: For every n>=2, every partition of {1,...,n} into complete truncated residue classes, each containing at least two points, has h=sum(1/m)>1891871140656049/1929687500000000>49/50. Distinct moduli are not required by the proof.
witness.evidence_class: Executed exact computer-assisted proof; independently recomputed by a same-session workstream; no proof-assistant formalization or external peer review.

proof_obligations.short_classes: 78 exact tensor-Bernstein patches for lengths2..40; independent generic Horner checker passes with95 leaves,maxdepth6.
proof_obligations.long_classes: Exact bound I+abs(f0)/40+TV(gprime)/(8*40^2)<1 covers all lengths>=41.
proof_obligations.all_interval_lengths: Independent telescoping centered-moment recurrence matches Euler-Maclaurin coefficients;16 rational Bernstein intervals and exactn2,3 prove midpoint average>I for alln>=2.
proof_obligations.refusal: Original coarse-grid witness has exact finite-class violation n26,m15,r11, with normalized left side1.0464113181398584>1.
